name: T-Mobile First Responders Discount
description: Discounted unlimited plans for first responders with T-Priority access and streaming perks
fullDescription: T-Mobile offers discounted Experience More and Experience Beyond unlimited plans for verified first responders, with access to T-Priority, T-Satellite, and streaming perks.
whatTheyOffer:
- Experience More and Experience Beyond plans with First Responder Savings (up to $20/line/month less than regular pricing)
- Access to T-Priority, T-Mobile's priority network for first responders
- Netflix Standard with ads and Hulu included on Experience Beyond
- T-Satellite texting included with Experience Beyond
- Unlimited 5G data, talk, and text
howToGetIt:
1. Visit a T-Mobile store or t-mobile.com/cell-phone-plans/first-responder-discounts
2. Choose an Experience plan with First Responder Savings
3. Verify first responder status within 45 days of activation
4. Re-verify once a year when asked, or the plan reverts to regular pricing
keywords: T-Mobile, first responder discount, firefighter, police, EMT, paramedic, 911 dispatcher, Experience More, Experience Beyond, T-Priority, cell phone, wireless plan
